decisions.reason: The consumer superfood drink mix lies far from the firm's waste-to-energy technology focus and shows no sign of traction, so the option is better abandoned and its resources moved to the core plants.
The modular plant extensions complement the flagship waste-to-energy plants and cost little to offer, so keeping this low-cost option open is sensible while plant demand is still uncertain.
WASTX Oil is a flagship with a dedicated page and launch communication, and its decentralized market potential is still unresolved, which justifies keeping the option alive.
The plastic-waste-to-fuel plant moved from a mention to its own page as a strategic focus, and its prospects in a growing market for plastic recycling remain open, so the firm keeps investing.
